description: Native HumMod hemorrhage-system probe using Hemorrhage.Switch and Hemorrhage.TargetRate. Engineering fidelity test only.

provenance.purpose: Measure native HumMod baroreflex, venous-return, cardiac-output, autonomic, and catecholamine response to native blood-volume loss.
limitations: The target rate is a HumMod model input, not a clinical hemorrhage-management recommendation.
